analisis: Suplemento dietario en cápsulas (nutracéutico) de Vitalabh, con aguaje, fenogreco y maca negra, más vitaminas A y E. Se toma 2 cápsulas al día; un frasco trae 60 cápsulas y dura un mes. Es el apoyo diario de la mujer que quiere más curvas sin agujas ni quirófano, junto con su comida y su rutina de pierna. Frasco negro mate con tapa y franja inferior fucsia, letras blancas y detalles rosados.
descripcion_visual_en: A matte black cylindrical plastic supplement bottle, about 1.6 times taller than wide, with a glossy hot-pink/magenta screw cap printed with a repeating small white 'VITALABH' wordmark pattern, and a solid hot-pink band wrapping the bottom fifth of the bottle. The black label shows, from top to bottom: a small pink VITALABH emblem with the white word 'VITALABH'; a huge bold white condensed word 'AGUAJE'; the line 'COMPLEX 3 EN 1' with 'COMPLEX' in white and '3 EN 1' in pink-red; a thin hot-pink banner reading 'SUPLEMENTO ALIMENTICIO EN CÁPSULAS'; a small white line 'A base de Aguaje, Fenogreco y Maca Negra'; a bold italic hot-pink 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN' with a pink swoosh underline; three small black rounded boxes outlined in pink joined by white plus signs reading '200mg AGUAJE', '400mg FENOGRECO' and '200mg MACA NEGRA'; and at the bottom '60 CÁPSULAS | (0.5 g c/u Cont. Neto 30g)' in small white type.

datos.publico: mujeres que quieren más volumen en glúteos y piernas
datos.adicional: 20 variaciones de su anuncio ganador (antes y después estilo animado 3D) para AGUAJE COMPLEX 3 EN 1. Tanda 2 de 2.

identidad_visual.color_palette: Primary: hot fuchsia #E6177F and deep magenta #B0105E. Secondary: bottle black #0E0E10, dark plum #2B1226 (the 'before' panel), bubblegum pink #FF8CC0, pale blush pink #FBE3EE and white #FFFFFF.
identidad_visual.visual_style: Winning reference style: glossy 3D animated cartoon (Pixar-like) before/after split screen, a dark moody 'before' panel on the left and a bright glowing fuchsia 'after' panel on the right, with the real black-and-fuchsia bottle as hero at the bottom right.
identidad_visual.visual_atmosphere: Playful, feminine, confident and aspirational; soft glow, sparkles and hearts on the 'after' side, muted and gloomy on the 'before' side.
identidad_visual.graphic_language: Rounded pill labels at the top of each panel, a curved white arrow crossing from 'before' to 'after', casual handwritten marker notes with small doodled arrows and hearts, white four-point sparkles, a round black seal with stars, a soft pink flower behind the bottle and a bottom row of three thin-line icons with small labels.
identidad_visual.text_typography: Same as the reference: headline in a heavy geometric sans-serif (Montserrat Black / ExtraBold look), all uppercase, tight leading, left-aligned, the first part in white and the second part in a contrasting color; subheadline in a clean regular sans-serif (Poppins Regular look) in sentence case, white; side notes in a casual handwritten marker script in sentence case; pill labels and seal in bold uppercase sans-serif; icon labels in small regular sans-serif.
identidad_visual.art_direction: Keep the exact composition of the winning reference: same split, same character, same blocks and positions; the bottle always sharp and identical to the photo; everything readable on a phone.
